info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Feedbacks-v2-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Feedback API allows users to access feedback related to job applications within the careers management system. This endpoint provides a read-only view of the feedback submitted by hiring managers and interviewers for various applicants. Common consumers include recruiters and HR professionals who require insights into the evaluation process. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their recruitment strategies and improve candidate engagement based on constructive feedback.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to access feedback data for various applications. It enables retrieving specific feedback entries to analyze user responses and improve application features.
